name: Ba Le French Sandwich Shop
notes: 6 photos: 5 were wall-mounted menu boards (a rice-plate/spring-roll board, a Vietnamese 'BANH MI' board, and an English 'SANDWICHES' board shot from 2 angles); 1 was a handwritten combo-deal sign (not a dish menu, skipped, dishes: []). The Vietnamese and English boards list the same 12 sandwiches bilingually and were merged into one set, priced from the clearer English board; the combo sign cross-checks the special sandwich price (5 x $8.25 = $41.25, matches). Rice-plate items 2-5 had overlapping/ambiguous two-line text across the board and were dropped rather than guessed; only the unambiguous first item and the plain spring-roll items were kept, several without a legible price.
